notes: Fixed Android 11+ package visibility so installed Pulse Alarm, Pulse Calendar and Pulse Notes are detected correctly.
Added rounded ripple feedback and a quick press-scale animation to Pulse Suite buttons.
Bumped Pulse Suite updater channel to v1.0.1.
Introduced Pulse Suite as the home for Pulse Alarm, Pulse Calendar and Pulse Notes.
Added Pulse Account sign in, account creation and account sync.
Added RS8 workspace join and connection status.
Added app detection with Install, Open and Update states.
Added guided Install / Update All with progress status.
Added light and dark appearance, Pulse Suite icon and splash screen.
Added first-open update changelog and version history support.
